items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And I've seen this manager, Sam Flashnick [Flizshnik], stop the whole train... He was very good. One of the best managers I've ever seen.

ctx.x: You had your own dining car too?

Yes, most of the time. Most of the time except in emergencies. And I've seen this manager, Sam Flashnick [Flizshnik], stop the whole train and wouldn't let it move until they put our car in the proper position. He was very good. One of the best managers I've ever seen. The road manager.
How long was he the manager?
